Being in Combat for #e${12-#d} seconds grants a Stack of 'Chaos Reshaped' for 7 seconds. Maintaining the first Stack for #e${12-#d} seconds grants a second Stack.

Exchanging damage refreshes the buff duration.

For Chaos Reshaped, being in Combat is defined as having either dealt or received damage within the last 5 seconds.

Benefits at Chaos Reshaped x1 and x2:
• x1: grants 20% increased damage
• x2: grants 35% increased damage and grants a periodic burst of healing

Healing burst builds up while the weapon is readied at a rate of 5? HP/s. The burst is released either every 7 seconds for a 35 HP heal or upon stowing the weapon, releasing the built-up health.

<bold Healing effect is bugged! /> At Chaos Reshaped x2, while this weapon is held, a healing charge builds at a rate of 5/HP per second in the background. When this reaches 35/HP (after 7 seconds), the healing effect activates, healing for 5/HP per second. 

Stowing this weapon immediately triggers any built-up healing at the time of stow, and each 35/HP cycle continuously flows into the next, making the healing effect constant for as long as the weapon remains equipped and perk remains active.

While this healing effect is active, from either holding the weapon or having stowed it, <bold NO OTHER SOURCE OF HEALING can heal you above /> <pvp < Max HP - (Currently Built Healing Amount) > /> 

Your Max HP (below 100 Health Stat) is 200 HP. Thus, this bug caps your 'maximum recoverable HP' at anywhere from <pvp 165HP /> to <pvp 195HP />, depending on where in the 7-second cycle the perk is currently at. This unrecoverable HP segment can only be restored by Chaos Reshaped's 5/HPs heal.

<bold Healing effect is bugged! /> 
While Chaos Reshaped x2 is active: 
Stowing the weapon or keeping it readied for 7 seconds grants a continous healing effect of 5 HP per second.

Stowing this weapon grants the effect for 1 to 7 seconds (cycling, it's complicated), while keeping it readied after activation makes the healing effectively constant.

<purple/> While this healing effect is active, <bold NO OTHER SOURCE OF HEALING CAN RESTORE THE FINAL [~5 to 35 HP] OF YOUR HEALTH BAR! /> 

This unrecoverable HP segment can only be healed by Chaos Reshaped's 5/HPs effect.

For more details, visit the perk description in the Destiny Data Compendium.
